item.title: Bottles Creator Mirko Brombin Wants Microsoft Office on Linux, Not Its Clones
item.description: Mirko Brombin is working to get Microsoft Office running reliably on Linux. He also thinks the apps cloning Office and Photoshop pixel for pixel cross a line. We talked about both, plus AI agents, Vanilla OS and his new Sinty OS.

item.title: Apple внедряет новую систему защиты от мошенничества
item.description:
